statement: Security and supply-chain hardening decisions (D-352, Torre por delegação do Daniel 22/11/2026): (1) keep TAIL-gate-fork-workflow and TAIL-ssdf-pw2-gate revoked (D-360) and migrate required check tower/gate in .github/rulesets/main.json to an external GitHub App outside workflows in a separate workflow/ruleset PR (D-087), keeping THREAT-gate open until installed; (2) do not accept residual risk on RISK-media-single-account (decided treatment: S3 Object Lock on the us-west-2 replica within Daniel's 18/11 < US$1/month envelope, open until implemented) or on RISK-personal-data-unregistered (other people's data, treatment routed to Daniel, open); (3) approve future CloudFormation import (without replacement) of open-university-web Lambda, IAM role and CloudFront into infra/aws/stacks/ plus a read-only post-deploy HTTP canary via a separate workflow PR (D-087), keeping RISK-site-iac-outside-tree assessed until implemented; (4) replace inert STD-train-ownership-refusals in CTRL-ssdf-po.2 with the active D-360 check (scripts/lib/model.py:independently_approved).
